name: Integration Dependency Diff
purpose: Record current integration dependencies and identify where boundary improvements are needed

summary.note: This analysis identifies integration points to inform the enforcement of integration boundaries

locations.details: Uses PaymentGatewayInterface which is correctly implemented by RazorpayPaymentGateway adapter
locations.evidence: PaymentService depends on PaymentGatewayInterface, not Razorpay\Api\Api directly

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Need to verify no direct Razorpay\Api\Api usage remains

locations.details: Uses GoogleAuthService which should depend on GoogleIdentityProviderInterface
locations.needs_verification: Check if GoogleAuthService depends on interface or concrete implementation

locations.details: May directly use Google\Client instead of depending on interface

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Direct Google\Client usage in application layer

locations.details: May directly use HTTP client or Guzzle instead of depending on ExchangeRateApiClientInterface

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Direct HTTP client usage in application layer

locations.details: May directly use Mail:: facade instead of depending on MailContractInterface
May directly use Mail:: facade for sending notifications
May directly use Mail:: facade for referral emails
May directly use Mail:: facade for payment emails

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Direct Mail:: facade usage in application layer

locations.details: May directly use Storage:: facade instead of depending on StorageContractInterface
May directly use Storage:: facade for file uploads
May directly use Storage:: facade for partner logo uploads

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Direct Storage:: facade usage in application layer

locations.details: May directly use GD or Intervention Image functions instead of depending on ImageProcessingContractInterface

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Direct image processing library usage in application layer

locations.details: May directly use SMS gateway APIs instead of depending on SmsContractInterface

current_integration_points.potential_violations: Direct SMS gateway usage in application layer

potential_improvements.improvement: Ensure GoogleAuthService depends on GoogleIdentityProviderInterface, not concrete Google\Client
potential_improvements.rationale: Follows dependency inversion principle, makes auth service testable

potential_improvements.improvement: Ensure ExchangeRateService depends on ExchangeRateApiClientInterface, not concrete HTTP client
potential_improvements.rationale: Allows exchanging exchange rate providers without changing service

potential_improvements.improvement: Ensure MailService depends on MailContractInterface, not Mail:: facade
potential_improvements.rationale: Allows exchanging mail providers (Mailgun, SendGrid, SES) without changing service

potential_improvements.improvement: Ensure NotificationService depends on notification contracts, not concrete implementations
potential_improvements.rationale: Separates notification orchestration from channel-specific implementations

potential_improvements.improvement: Ensure MediaHelper depends on storage and image processing contracts, not concrete implementations
potential_improvements.rationale: Allows exchanging storage providers (local/S3) and image processing libraries (GD/Intervention) without changing helper

potential_improvements.improvement: Ensure UploadService depends on StorageContractInterface, not Storage:: facade
Ensure PartnerService depends on StorageContractInterface for logo uploads
Ensure NotificationService depends on SmsContractInterface for SMS sending

verification_required: Check app/Domain and app/Application layers for any direct external service calls
Verify all external service usage goes through appropriate adapter interfaces
Check that adapter implementations correctly implement their interfaces
Verify that adapter implementations are properly registered in the service container
Ensure no framework-specific code leaks into domain layer
